fetal renal organogenesis is regulated by at least two humoral growth factors, transferrin and a prostaglandin, and that these factors are necessary for optimal metanephric growth and differentiation in a serum-free murine metanephric culture system.

metanephric development in vitro requires transferrin and PGE1 for optimal growth and PGE1 is also necessary for maximal metagenesis in vitro.
